scenario_summary: Ride-hailing platform (Uber / Lyft comparable scale) contracts per-transaction payment processing with PayRoute. No monthly base fee — 100% variable. Three pricing tiers reward high volume: $0.0100/transaction up to 5M, $0.0075 for 5M–20M, $0.0050 above 20M. SprintPay processed ~12M transactions/month in the prior year. Revenue recognized as each transaction is processed per ASC 606-10-55-18.
_note_on_tcv: TCV is $0 at inception — all consideration is variable. The constrained VC estimate ($1,230,000 annual) is used for balance-sheet and disclosure purposes.

performance_obligations.name: Payment Processing API
performance_obligations.description: Per-transaction payment authorisation, capture, and settlement API. SprintPay calls the API for every rider charge, driver payout, tip, and refund processed through its iOS/Android apps. No minimum commitment — SprintPay pays only for volume processed.

recognition_params._tier_rationale: Tier 1 covers standard merchant volumes; Tier 2 matches SprintPay's current run-rate; Tier 3 activates during peak seasons (New Year's Eve, major sporting events) when surge pricing drives transaction spikes.

variable_consideration.description: SprintPay averaged 11.2M transactions/month over the prior 12 months. Management projects modest growth from new market launches in 3 cities (Q3). Holiday and events season (Nov–Dec) historically adds 25–40% volume. Constraint applied to base scenario to avoid reversal risk from the high scenario.

monthly_scenarios.label: low
monthly_scenarios.comment: Market expansion delayed; volume retreats to 3M transactions/month (Tier 1 only)

monthly_scenarios.label: base
monthly_scenarios.comment: Consistent with prior-year run-rate; 12M transactions spans Tiers 1 and 2

monthly_scenarios.label: high
monthly_scenarios.comment: 3-city expansion + strong holiday surge; 25M transactions reaches Tier 3

variable_consideration._constraint_rationale: City expansion is unexecuted at contract signing; high scenario not yet probable. Constraining to base ($102,500/month) per ASC 606-10-32-11 avoids recognising the $85,000/month incremental revenue that is subject to probable significant reversal.

payment_schedule._note: Billed monthly in arrears on actuals

_key_asc606_considerations: Revenue recognised as each transaction is processed — the fee relates specifically to PayRoute's distinct act of authorising and settling that payment (ASC 606-10-55-18 usage-based analogy).
No contract asset or liability: SprintPay is invoiced monthly on actuals, so billings coincide with recognition; balance stays near zero each month.
VC constraint must be reassessed at each reporting period as new transaction data arrives; if actuals consistently exceed base scenario, cumulative catch-up adjustment is recognised in that period.
Tiered pricing creates a non-linear revenue curve — incremental rate drops 50% when SprintPay crosses 20M transactions, so the Tier 3 savings are a meaningful incentive for volume growth.
If SprintPay launches in a new country mid-contract, assess whether the new territory constitutes a modification (new separate contract vs. expanded scope of original POB).
Disclosure: significant judgement in VC constraint selection; disclose the range of outcomes ($360k–$2.25M annual) and the constraint rationale per ASC 606-10-50-20.
